text: LIFE IN MADAGASCAR THE STRANGE ISLAND WHERE NATURE EVOLVED DIFFERENTLY What if there was an island where animals looked like they came from another planet? Where trees grow with enormous trunks and strange shapes. Where tiny villages disappear into forests. Where people travel by wooden boats, walk for hours to reach markets, and build their lives around rice, fishing, cattle, and family. And where more than eighty percent of the species found on the island exist nowhere else on Earth. This is Madagascar.
